root.label: Missouri August 4 2026 ballot measure on citizen-sponsored amendments

events.label: Missouri August 4 2026 ballot measure on citizen-sponsored amendments

slots.name: number of passed amendments since 2020
slots.sentence: None of the four amendments Missouri voters have passed since 2020 have won in all congressional districts.

slots.name: vote result
slots.sentence: Missouri voters on Tuesday overwhelmingly rejected an attempt by the Republican-controlled Legislature to make it harder to pass citizen-sponsored amendments to the state’s constitution, preserving a tool that voters across the country have relied on to pass laws their legislatures would not.

slots.name: number of states allowing citizen-sponsored constitutional amendments
slots.sentence: That would have been the highest threshold in any of the 18 states that allow citizen groups to place constitutional amendments on the ballot.
